Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms

Class SmsOutbox

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms.SmsOutbox
All Implemented Interfaces:
SmsInbox
public final class SmsOutbox extends Object implements SmsInbox
Bounded, thread-safe, in-memory record of the messages the LoggingSmsSender "sent", so the development inbox can show them, which reads it through the domain port SmsInbox. The oldest message is evicted when the capacity is reached.
